rules.universe: US stocks over $25B by sector (FMP screener), top 15 per sector by market cap, plus an AI watchlist; current holdings always re-screened
rules.quality: gate: ROIC ≥ 12% (financials ROE ≥ 12%), operating margin ≥ 10% and not down more than 3 pts over 2 years, operating cash flow ≥ 80% of net income, net debt ≤ 3x EBITDA; relaxed for financials, REITs, utilities and thin-margin sectors
rules.growth: score = percentile ranks: 40% forward 2-yr EPS growth, 25% forward revenue growth, 20% trailing 3-yr EPS growth, 15% estimate revisions and analyst grades
rules.valuation: new entrants need price/sales ≤ 20, trailing P/E between 0 and 60, PEG ≤ 3; a holding leaves only if price/sales passes 25
rules.removal: fundamental only: next-FY EPS consensus cut more than 5% in ~60 days, two straight earnings misses, or failing the quality gate 2 runs in a row; no price-based removals
rules.watch: one earnings miss, an estimate trim of 2–5%, one quality-gate strike, or a price 25%+ below the 52-week high (information only)
rules.sizing: sector slots weighted like the S&P (tech 9, financials 5, others 2–4) plus up to 8 AI-watchlist names not already in core, screened on the same rules; sectors are left empty if nothing passes
rules.stability: 42–50 names; a holding leaves only on a removal trigger or, at most 2 times a week, when a challenger outscores it by 15+ points; 52-week return breaks ties only
